initialSnapshot.sceneConfigurationScope: Presentation preset and camera at capture time only; camera motion during the recorded run is not replayed. Physical stateLabel excludes presentation.
initialSnapshot.disturbancePhase: absolute simulation time and observer RNG state are in physical snapshot

state.status: 定姿定点待命：接触表面，喷口保持让行

finalSnapshot.sceneConfigurationScope: Presentation preset and camera at capture time only; camera motion during the recorded run is not replayed. Physical stateLabel excludes presentation.
finalSnapshot.disturbancePhase: absolute simulation time and observer RNG state are in physical snapshot

observationPolicy.outerLoop: Uses configured position/velocity measurement when enabled; otherwise ideal pre-step truth.
observationPolicy.innerLoop: Existing bounded position/attitude feedback uses the same declared observation model; wheel/contact switches remain ideal.
observationPolicy.timeBasis: controllerIO.timeS is relative task time; observationTimeS is absolute simulation time, including the 2 s settled fixture prelude and any declared delay.
observationPolicy.trace: Each control decision retains target/actual observation, pre-step truth, request, bounded application and post-integration physical response. Applied acceleration is a control request, not achieved acceleration.

summary.source: all 120 Hz post-integration physical states; display curves do not define statistics
summary.heightResponseMeaning: Settling is measured from the 1 s start of the constant target, at every 120 Hz state; the final uninterrupted height/vertical-speed band must persist at least 0.5 s through 6 s. Null means no qualification in that window. Overshoot uses the same 1–6 s window. Fixed-window gas is 0–6 s only; partial failed runs retain their shorter duration.
summary.recoveryMeaning: Time from the last applied scheduled wind change to sustained stable landing, including commanded descent; not isolated wind-response settling time.
summary.clearanceMeaning: Minimum vertical AABB hull gap to the actual flat laboratory floor; estimate of collision envelope, not tyre travel, city AGL, or recovery height.

preview.seedMeaning: Reserved observer RNG seed retained in the initial snapshot. V1 uses ideal measurements and prescribed deterministic gusts, no stochastic disturbance.

timeline.event: descent begins; target reaches 0.45 m at 10 s

preview.authority: Height outer-loop AST → bounded acceleration → existing position/attitude control, allocation, valves and gas. Pilot input cancels.

sampling.note: All controller decisions are retained at declared controlHz. Primary statistics use every 120 Hz state.

restored: model parameter settings including gas supply mode
retained: actual remaining gas mass; no refill
